FRAGILE GAIN: proj.weight has gain up to 11.96 along input directions that carry only 1% of the training-feature variance (outside the top-821 principal components of 1,536 unlabelled practice features), versus 1.73 along the top PC; the init had a flat gain of ~0.36 everywhere, so this gain was grown by Adam/DiLoCo updates in directions with almost no training signal. A new domain that moves features along those directions gets that motion amplified 12x into the residual stream as noise. Edit: remove W's component on the low-variance subspace and fold its effect at the training-feature mean into proj.bias, so train-domain outputs move only by W(I-P)(x-mu).
